lines.1: Right. As her senior, shouldn't I seize the initiative by displaying my boundless intellect?
lines.8: 「It's common knowledge. Do you know the Summer Triangle?」
lines.9: 「I learned it in elementary school, but I've almost forgotten...」
lines.10: 「But I know Chamaeleon, Apus, and Triangulum Australe perfectly.」
lines.14: 「The fact that you can't see them from Japan... Don't you think there's something romantic about that?」
lines.15: 「Words like 'the open sea,' 'uncharted country,' or 'the south celestial pole'--don't they stir your sense of adventure?」
lines.16: 「...I don't quite understand, but I would like to see them.」
lines.18: 「What a relief. I'd have been crushed if you'd called even that opinion disgusting.」
